compute_iou_between_mask_lists: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two BoxMaskList collections of masks
compute_ioa_between_mask_lists: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two BoxMaskList collections of masks
non_max_suppression_masks: apply non-maximum suppression to a BoxMaskList using mask IOU threshold and score filtering
multi_class_nms_masks: apply multi-class non-maximum suppression to a BoxMaskList across multiple detection classes
filter_scores_greater_than: filter a BoxMaskList to keep only boxes and masks with scores exceeding a threshold
